name: Zeno
source:
While Knight Zeno doesn’t have as much esteem or as many accomplishments as Dyclos, he is respected and loved amongst the people for his great achievements. Saving cities, rescuing families—Knight Zeno is known for taking any quest that would assist the common Vallaurian.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
